theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  let f := fun n : ℕ => Φ (ZMod.ofNat n)
  have h_abscissa_le : LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f ≤ ↑s.re :=
    LSeriesSummable.abscissaOfAbsConv_le f s
  let h_abscissa_lt : LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f < ↑s.re :=
    begin
      rw lt_iff_le_not_le at h_abscissa_le,
      intro h_le,
      contradiction
    end
  exact LSeriesSummable_lt_re_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt_re h_abscissa_lt
